dedupe_keys.name: 3d city model of new york city

description: The TUM Chair of Geoinformatics publishes a semantic three-dimensional model of New York City derived from NYC Open Data. Its project page describes buildings, land parcels, roads, parks, terrain and water bodies in CityGML, with KML, COLLADA and glTF exports. The road-space collection distinguishes roadbeds, sidewalks, intersections, curbs, parking areas and other objects. It includes city-wide LoD1 and LoD2 products, a detailed Manhattan street-space example and a separate LoD0 linear network. The provider identifies traffic simulations, solar irradiation analysis and work on deriving VISSIM input as applications. Coverage is New York City, with detail varying by product. Access is free through linked files; original providers retain ownership and NYC Open Data conditions apply. Caveats include base heights of zero for most objects other than LoD2 buildings, possible automatic-generation errors and differing object structures across products. These limits matter for geometry-dependent infrastructure studies. Related TUM2TWIN data describe a separate Munich site. Only descriptive metadata and file-link descriptors were reviewed; no archive or viewer was opened.
